turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, and why did nobody call me before my son's mark was changed?
I'm sorry? Owen's mark. Who decided on the zero?
Tell me what you had for breakfast, then spell it backwards.
I'm not here for a party trick. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
Then tell me something only a real mother would know about her son.
I'm not the one being questioned. Who decided on the zero?
